what: For fabric (multi-device) ops, --dev multi-test runs fail after the first test: every mesh re-open times out on Ethernet cores. The mandated --dev run of the acceptance suite hung to the 10-min tool timeout before I fell back to non-dev. Same wall the implementer hit.
suggest: For fabric ops, allow non-dev for multi-test runs and reserve --dev for single-test hang triage (or have run_safe_pytest.sh reset between fabric tests under --dev).

what: Skill says ops_perf_results column 19 = DEVICE KERNEL DURATION [ns]; in the current CSV column 19 is DEVICE FW DURATION and column 20 is DEVICE KERNEL DURATION. The provided awk snippet reads the wrong column.
suggest: Read the column by header name instead of by index in the skill snippet.

what: L1 profiling fails any graded test whose op call is a correct support refusal inside pytest.raises (peak_total=0), so a correct refusal shows up as xfail_wrong_mode, a loud category the verifier is told must be 0. It cannot be fixed op-side because validate() must run before any allocation.
suggest: Skip the positive-peak check when the op raised a SupportRefusal (or for tests with no graded allocation), or document the artifact in verify_supported.
